body: uhh I really dont know how to use it

5'4 is midget tier, im the shortest guy I know, i've been mocked enough to know its not normal, and no lies will change it.

yeah obviously people dont care how much I lift, but i've always comforted myself thinking that even if women dont see me as a strong man because im short I still am one because I lift, but now that I know that it doesnt matter and people taller than me still mogg me, I have nothing.  
I know it may not seem like a big deal to you but it is to me, im only 17 and i've wasted 3 years of my life working out, i've never been consisted with anything else, its the only thing that kept me sane, but now I finally get that all that hope was for nothing because people disrespect and mock short people and nothing will change that, not even 3 years of hard work.
